title: Pocketwise
summary: A budget tracker that helps young families see where their money goes, in one tap.
cover_alt: Two phones showing the Pocketwise budget and spending screens

story.p: Most budgeting apps ask for **twenty minutes of setup** before showing anything useful, so people give up in the first week.

story.quote: Just tell me if we can afford dinner out this weekend.

ul: **Learn, don't ask.** Categories are guessed from the first ten expenses.
**Offline first.** Everything works on patchy data and syncs later.
**One number.** The home screen shows only what is *left to spend* this week.

story.alt: Early sketch of the one-tap setup
story.caption: Early sketch of the one-tap setup, before any code.

story.p: Each expense is saved on the phone first, then sent to `Supabase` when the connection returns. The newest change wins.

story.callout: The sync engine is open source: [read the code on GitHub](https://github.com/example/pocketwise).

story.text: fewer people leave in the first week
